footer.tagline: A virtual tour and trip planning platform for Indonesia. Preview destinations in 360° panoramas, then build a journey that fits your time and interests.
footer.copyright: © {year} Jelajah Nusantara. Built to promote Indonesian tourism.
footer.credits: 360° panoramas by Pannellum · Maps by OpenStreetMap

hero.description: Spin around {title}, discover hidden destinations, and plan the perfect route — all in one place.
hero.dragHint: Drag the panorama to look around

home.featuredDesc: From temple masterpieces to legendary beaches — explore them all in 360°.
home.routesDesc: Every route includes a visit order, time estimates, and an interactive map.
home.howTitle: From screen to location, no surprises
home.howDesc: We summarise everything you need to know before you leave.
home.step1Desc: Feel the atmosphere before you arrive. Every panorama can be rotated, zoomed, and explored freely.
home.step2Desc: Routes are arranged by visit order, time estimates, and practical notes from our team.
home.step3Desc: See where destinations sit on the map, check tickets and opening hours, then adjust the itinerary to your pace.
home.ctaTitle: Build your own travel route with us.
home.ctaDesc: Have a special plan? The management team can create new routes, add destinations, and update 360° panoramas at any time through the admin panel.
home.note: Ticket prices and opening hours may change. Please confirm before visiting.

destinations.metaDesc: Browse Indonesian tourist destinations with 360° panoramas, tickets, opening hours, and facilities.
destinations.title: Find your next stop
destinations.desc: Filter by interest and location. Click a card to see the 360° panorama, ticket details, and routes that pass through it.
destinations.emptyDesc: Try another keyword, loosen the category or city filter, or browse the full catalogue.

destination.relatedRoutesDesc: Combine this destination with other stops in a single journey.
destination.noTicket: No ticket information. Some destinations are free.
destination.tipsBody: Arrive in the morning for a calmer atmosphere and the best light for panoramic photos.
destination.panoramaUnavailable: A 360° panorama is not available for this destination.

routes.metaDesc: Curated Indonesian travel routes: visit order, time estimates, and interactive maps.
routes.title: Journeys already thought through
routes.desc: Each route includes a destination order, estimated visit times, and an interactive map. Use it as a starting point, then adjust it to your pace.
routes.emptyDesc: Routes will appear here once they are marked as published in the admin panel.

route.itineraryDesc: The visit order and a short note for every stop.
route.travelNoteBody: Time estimates are flexible. Check opening hours and public holidays, and confirm tickets before you leave.
route.family: Families travelling at a relaxed pace
route.tourLoading: Loading the 360° tour for this route…
route.hotspotHint: Click the “Continue to…” hotspot to move to the next destination
route.noPanorama: No 360° panorama is available for the destinations on this route.

pannellum.fileAccessError: The panorama file could not be accessed.
pannellum.iOS8WebGLError: Your browser does not support WebGL, so the 360° panorama cannot be displayed.
pannellum.textureSizeError: The panorama image is too large to load.
pannellum.twoTouchActivate: Use two fingers to look around
pannellum.twoTouchXActivate: Use two fingers to look around horizontally
pannellum.twoTouchYActivate: Use two fingers to look around vertically
pannellum.ctrlZoomActivate: Hold Ctrl and scroll to zoom
pannellum.empty: No 360° panorama photo is available for this destination.
pannellum.error: Failed to load the panorama. Make sure the image URL is valid and accessible.

map.empty: This route has no stops yet.

login.metaDesc: Sign in to manage destinations and travel routes.
login.heroTitle: Manage the stories of the archipelago.
login.heroDesc: Update destinations, upload 360° panoramas, and craft routes that inspire thousands of travellers.
login.formDesc: Use a registered admin account to manage content.
login.note: Use an admin account registered in the database.

dashboard.title: Content overview
dashboard.desc: Monitor the destinations and routes shown on the public site.
dashboard.quickAddDesc: Fill in ticket info, opening hours, and 360° panoramas.
dashboard.quickRouteDesc: Set destination order and visit schedule.
dashboard.quickSiteDesc: See how the content looks to visitors.
dashboard.quickThemeDesc: Choose theme colors or use an available preset.

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.emptyDesc: Try another keyword or reset the search.
destinations.emptyAllDesc: Add your first destination to start building the tourism catalog.
destinations.deleteConfirm: Delete destination “{title}”? It will also be removed from all routes.

routes.title: Tour routes
routes.emptyDesc: Create your first route by selecting destinations and arranging the visit order.
routes.deleteConfirm: Delete route “{title}”? All stops inside will also be deleted.

form.newDestinationDesc: Fill in the destination information. Fields marked * are required.
form.newRouteDesc: Enter the route information, then arrange the order of destinations visited.
form.basicInfoDesc: Name, category, and description shown on the public page.
form.slugHint: Leave blank to generate automatically from the name.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the destination's highlights. Separate paragraphs with a blank line.
form.mediaDesc: Use landscape images for covers and equirectangular panoramas (2:1 ratio) for the 360° viewer.
form.panoramaHint: Equirectangular 360° photo with a 2:1 ratio (e.g. 4096×2048 px), max 20 MB.
form.locationDesc: Coordinates are used for map markers and directions buttons.
form.visitInfoDesc: Tickets, opening hours, and facilities. All fields are optional.
form.hoursDaysHint: Separate with commas, e.g. Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday.
form.saveNote: Changes appear on the public site immediately.
form.routeInfoDesc: Draft routes are only visible to admins and do not appear on the public site.
form.summaryPlaceholder: Explain the theme and flow of this route.
form.itineraryDesc: Arrange the visit order. Numbers follow the position from top to bottom.
form.noDestinations: No destinations yet. Add destinations before planning a route.
form.noStopsDesc: Click “Add stop” to choose the first destination.

theme.title: Appearance & theme
theme.desc: Adjust the site colors to match your destination's identity.
theme.configDesc: Overview of content and appearance available in the dashboard.
theme.destItem3: Map coordinates, ticket info, opening hours
theme.paletteDesc: Choose a preset and adjust as needed. Changes apply immediately across all public pages and the dashboard.
theme.mainColorHint: Buttons, links, icons, and main highlights.
theme.accentColorHint: Small labels, badges, and highlight elements.
theme.darkColorHint: Text headings and dark panels. Choose a very dark color to keep text readable.
theme.savedPermanently: The theme is saved permanently in the database.
theme.previewDesc: Wander the relief corridors and enjoy the sunrise from the temple terraces.
theme.previewNote: The preview uses a palette generated automatically from the three colors above. The default colors preserve the site's original look.

delete.label: Delete
delete.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this data? This action cannot be undone.

notFound.title: Looks like you are lost
notFound.desc: We could not find the page you were looking for. It may have moved or the address may be mistyped.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.desc: We could not load this page. Try again, or return home if the problem continues.
